# Draft:Finno-Korean Hyperwar

The Finno-Korean Hyperwar is an internet meme about a prehistoric conflict between two fictional nation-states called the Finnic Imperium and the Great Hwan Empire, which are portrayed as ancient predecessors to modern Finland and Korea respectively.

* Finland–North Korea relations
* Hwan-guk
* Hyperborea
